title: SCVal nested one vector deeper than stellar-core's decoder admits
caps_note: A decoder limit, not a CAP.
why: stellar-core's decoder stops at 499 nested vectors; a reader with a deeper limit accepts a value core itself refuses.

source.recipe: literal: 500 nested one-element SCV_VEC values around SCV_VOID
source.reason: stellar-core cannot decode the value, so it never emits it

reject.note: The depth is stated in stellar-xdr units, converted from stellar-core's decoder boundary.
